source_snapshots.title: Micron Technology, Inc. Reports Record Results for the Third Quarter of Fiscal 2026
source_snapshots.normalized_extract: FQ3-26 revenue USD41,456m, GAAP gross profit USD35,056m, GAAP operating income USD33,318m, GAAP net income USD28,243m and operating cash flow USD25,388m. Net capital expenditures were USD7,084m and adjusted free cash flow was USD18,304m. HBM4 was in high-volume shipment for a lead customer platform with qualification samples to multiple end-customers.

source_snapshots.title: Micron Fiscal Q3 2026 Earnings Call Prepared Remarks
source_snapshots.locator: PDF pages 1-10; SCA pages 1-3, supply pages 4-5, financials pages 7-9
source_snapshots.normalized_extract: Micron disclosed 16 strategic customer agreements, usually five-year terms, tight DRAM and NAND conditions beyond calendar 2027, FQ3 DRAM revenue about USD31.3bn, company and business-unit results, USD8.6bn ending inventory and 120 inventory days.

source_snapshots.title: Micron Fiscal Q3 2026 Earnings Presentation
source_snapshots.locator: PDF pages 3-7 and financial appendix; demand, supply and HBM trade-ratio statements
source_snapshots.normalized_extract: The deck states DRAM and NAND demand exceeded supply, tightness was expected beyond 2027, greenfield constraints limit supply, and each HBM generation increases trade ratio and pressure on non-HBM supply.

source_snapshots.title: Micron Technology Fiscal Q3 2026 Form 10-Q
source_snapshots.locator: PDF consolidated statements and risk factors, especially page 6 HBM demand and manufacturing intensity
source_snapshots.normalized_extract: The filing provides issuer GAAP statements and cautions that long-term generative-AI/HBM demand may fluctuate; HBM requires more wafers and cleanroom space per bit than conventional DRAM and capacity can be shifted if HBM demand weakens.

source_snapshots.title: Micron in High-Volume Production of HBM4 Designed for NVIDIA Vera Rubin
source_snapshots.normalized_extract: Micron began volume shipment of HBM4 36GB 12H in calendar Q1 2026, designed for NVIDIA Vera Rubin, with over 11 Gb/s pin speed, more than 2.8 TB/s bandwidth and greater than 20% power-efficiency improvement versus HBM3E under the stated test boundary.

source_snapshots.title: Micron High-Bandwidth Memory Product Page
source_snapshots.normalized_extract: The product page identifies HBM4 36GB 12H as in high-volume production and states more than 11 Gb/s pin speed, greater than 2.8 TB/s bandwidth and greater than 20% power efficiency improvement versus HBM3E.

evidence_rows.statement: Micron stated that HBM4 was in high-volume shipments for its lead customer's platform and that qualification samples had shipped to multiple end-customers.
evidence_rows.claim_boundary: Supports shipment and qualification status only; no named customer, HBM revenue, margin or customer share.

evidence_rows.statement: Micron stated that it began volume shipment of HBM4 36GB 12H in calendar Q1 2026 and that the product was designed for NVIDIA Vera Rubin.
evidence_rows.claim_boundary: Product and platform context only; does not prove NVIDIA purchase volume, revenue attribution or exclusivity.

evidence_rows.statement: Micron disclosed 16 strategic customer agreements, typically with five-year terms through calendar 2030, to provide customers contracted supply assurance.
evidence_rows.citation: PDF pages 1-10; SCA pages 1-3, supply pages 4-5, financials pages 7-9
evidence_rows.claim_boundary: The agreements are company-level and cannot be attributed to HBM, a named customer, product generation or margin.

evidence_rows.statement: Micron stated that DRAM and NAND demand exceeded supply, tight conditions were expected beyond calendar 2027, and HBM trade-ratio growth pressures non-HBM supply.
evidence_rows.citation: PDF pages 3-7 and financial appendix; demand, supply and HBM trade-ratio statements
evidence_rows.claim_boundary: Forward-looking issuer outlook; does not establish realized future pricing, HBM demand durability or competitor supply.

evidence_rows.statement: Micron reported FQ3-26 company GAAP revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income and operating cash flow, plus business-unit revenue and margin tables.
evidence_rows.claim_boundary: Company and disclosed business-unit scope only; none is an HBM-specific revenue or profit row.

evidence_rows.statement: Micron attributed FQ3 DRAM and business-unit changes to pricing, bit shipments and mix, and disclosed USD8.6bn ending inventory with 120 inventory days.
evidence_rows.citation: PDF pages 1-10; SCA pages 1-3, supply pages 4-5, financials pages 7-9
evidence_rows.claim_boundary: Does not permit an HBM-specific price-volume-mix decomposition or product profit allocation.

evidence_rows.statement: Micron cautioned that the long-term trajectory of generative-AI/HBM demand is unknown and may fluctuate, while HBM requires more wafers and cleanroom space per bit than conventional DRAM.
evidence_rows.citation: PDF consolidated statements and risk factors, especially page 6 HBM demand and manufacturing intensity
evidence_rows.claim_boundary: Risk mechanism and uncertainty boundary; it does not quantify probability, impact, yield or future capacity.
